CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  June 14, 2022

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

 •  ROLL CALL:
  Present:  Ankit Udani, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  Absent:  None
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Vist Yang

CONSENT AGENDA

All items on the consent agenda will be addressed under a single motion unless a Design Review
Board Member of a member of the public requests that the item be heard under the Discussion
Agenda.

ITEM 1: DRB MINUTES - May 24, 2022

ITEM 2: 1 E. Hellman Avenue
This application is for a new wall sign at an existing commercial building for the business known
as "Pho Ever".
Applicant: Christopher Kim, Cost Sign Inc., DBA KBJ Sign

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

ACTION MINUTES:
Items 1 and 2 were approved on the consent agenda

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the consent calendar.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Ankit Udani, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: None

  1
 DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 3: 3136 West Main Street
This application is for new signage at an existing commercial building for the business known as
"Legaspi Family Dental”.
Applicant: John Estrada, Sign Crafter Inc

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that the font used
for the blade sign shall be similar to the san serif font used in the second line of the main sign.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was Sign Crafters, Inc. was present. Staff comments were given.

The applicant stated that he was accepting of the staff comments and that he would match the font
of the secondary signage shown as “FAMILY DENTAL”. Hernandez reiterated that there should
be font consistency between the main sign and the blade sign regardless of the actual name of the
font. All board members concurred with staff direction and the Board discussion.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application with the condition that the blade sign font shall
  match the san serif font used in the second line of the main sign.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Ankit Udani, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: None

ITEM 4: 30 West Valley Boulevard
This application is for a uniform sign program for an existing commercial building.
Applicant: Tony Chen, 3D Tech Signs

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for continuance.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was present. The staff report was given.

The applicant stated that the direction from the City planner implied that the level of information
submitted was adequate. Mr. Abe explained the purposes of the Uniform Sign Program for both the
tenant and the City. The intention is to make the process easier for the current and future tenants.
Several areas of the submittal were highlighted to illustrate the missing information.

The tenant spoke to explain the signage intention for the building and stated that the building owner
was aware and in support of that design intent. The sign contractor stated that he would be able to
address the missing information and update the documentation.

  2
 The Board members concurred that the applicant should work with DRB staff to enable a timely
resubmittal.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to continue the application.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Ankit Udani, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: None

ADJOURNMENT:

There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:00 P.M. to July 12, 2022.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:00 P.M.
 •  Seconded by Daninger
  Ayes:  Ankit Udani, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: None

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 28th day of June, 2022.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
